newsitem.title: SPAIN: ATHLETICS-INJURED CACHO IN ATHENS SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-INJURED CACHO IN ATHENS SQUAD.

text.p: Fermin Cacho was included in the 47-member Spanish team announced on Thursday for next month's world championships despite a knee injury.
The 1992 Olympic 1,500 metres champion and silver medallist over the same distance in Atlanta last year damaged knee ligaments during training earlier this month.
Cacho withdrew from the Spanish championships last weekend but hopes to compete in Athens.
Spain's title hopes include world marathon champion Martin Fiz and World Cup winner Jesus Garcia in the 50 km walk.
